newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares come off lows to end largely flat.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares come off lows to end largely flat.

text.p: Swedish shares managed to claw back intra day losses to end flat on Friday as the market welcomed a lower than expected U.S. PPI figure. A following impressive performance on Wall Street also inspired.
The exchange's general index rose 0.03 percent to 2,764.43 in turnover of 4.32 billion crowns. Dealers described trade as relatively quiet.
"Prices turned when U.S. statistics were released but we were still not doing as well as other European bourses today," a trader said.
Telecoms group Ericsson climbed 2.5 crowns to 272.

Drugs major Astra also regained its strength as the company won European approval for its asthma treatment Oxis Turbuhaler which it plans to launch in Europe in the beginning of the next quarter. Astra rose two crowns to 366.5.
"The share also found support in a firm dollar," a trader said.
The U.S. currency also spurred automotive group Volvo which ended four crowns higher at 191.
Banking group Handelsbanken fell six crowns to 228 crowns after going strong lately.
